Solcap capture file format headers, chunk types, and size limits.

# Purpose
Defines the binary layout and constants for the `solcap` capture file format used to store Solana runtime data for replay and debugging. It declares the file header, chunk header, and account table entry structures, and it documents how chunk magic values identify different chunk types such as `BANK`, `ACCT`, `ACTB`, and `TRXN`. The file also provides a helper function, [`fd_solcap_is_chunk_magic`](<#fd_solcap_is_chunk_magic>), to test whether a value matches a valid chunk magic pattern. In addition, it sets fixed size limits for file metadata and Protobuf payloads used by the format.
